## Brakeman Report Visualizer

{{ '/brakeman-visualizer/' | absolute_url }}

A free, 100% client-side dashboard to triage Brakeman static analysis reports for Ruby on Rails: compare two scans (new, fixed and unchanged warnings), triage each warning (to fix, false positive, accepted risk) with a severity and a note, and export config/brakeman.ignore. Reports never leave the browser.
